_about: Christmas pack calls (js/packs/christmas.js, calls), generated with the ElevenLabs Sound Effects API by tools/gen-sounds.js --manifest tools/packs/christmas.sounds.json and levelled into sounds/ by tools/pick-sounds.js --manifest. The friends who aren't animals make the sound they really would. The robin and the Christmas beetle reuse the Classic 'tweet' and 'buzz'. Every call has a synthesised stand-in.
common: close-up, isolated, no music, no speech, no background noise

sounds.prompt: A tiny cartoon gingerbread cookie character giggling hee-hee-hee, very high, squeaky and cute
Tiny glass Christmas baubles and little bells jingling together softly, a short cheerful ting-a-ling
One bright magical bell ding with a soft sparkling shimmer, like a star twinkling
A cartoon wobbly jelly pudding wobbling, boing-oing-oing, squishy and cute
A wooden nutcracker toy clacking its jaw twice, clack clack, then a walnut cracking
A short magical run of bright twinkling celesta bell notes going up, music box sparkle
A cartoon mouse giving one proud bossy squeak, eek, cute
Tiny icicles and little glass wind chimes tinkling, a short icy shimmer
A soft angelic choir humming one gentle warm aah note, heavenly
A reindeer giving a short snort and grunt while its harness sleigh bells jingle
A soft low hooting whistle like blowing across a bottle, one gentle hooo, wintry
